parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: Group
parameters.description: The name of the configuration group.

parameters.name: NamespaceId
parameters.description: The namespace ID. Default value: public

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the cluster is located. MSE supports specific regions.

parameters.name: RequestPars
parameters.description: The extended request parameter in the JSON format.
